description: Session is the logbook entry: one budgeted, recorded run.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: SessionSpec defines one run: who, on what input, and where it came from.

agentRef.description: AgentRef names the Agent executing this session.

prompt.description:
Prompt is the fully rendered task prompt, event payload fenced as
untrusted data.

provenance.description: Provenance records the originating trigger and event.

cliVersion.description: CLIVersion is the agent CLI version inside the runner.

eventType.description: EventType is the normalized CloudEvent type, e.g. alertmanager.firing.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint is the dedupe fingerprint of the originating event.

runnerImageDigest.description: RunnerImageDigest pins the runner image that executed the session.

triageVerdict.description: TriageVerdict is the triage classification, when triage ran.

trigger.description: Trigger is the Trigger that created this session.

status.description: SessionStatus is the immutable record a finished session leaves behind.

a2aTaskState.description: A2ATaskState is the phase in A2A vocabulary, for the gateway edge.

artifacts.description: Artifacts locate the transcript, report, and branches.

branches.description:
Branches pushed by the session, always matching the agent's allowed
patterns.

report.description: Report is the URI of the session's report, when one was produced.

transcript.description: Transcript is the URI of the stream-json transcript.

completedAt.description: CompletedAt is when the session reached a terminal phase.

conditions.description: Conditions describe scheduling and execution detail.

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description:
lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.
This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description:
message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition.
This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description:
reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition.
Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field,
and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API.
The value should be a CamelCase string.
This field may not be empty.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

jobName.description: JobName is the Job executing this session.

summary.description: Summary is the runner-reported outcome in one paragraph.

usage.description: Usage is the metered spend, reported by the runner shim.

apiEquivalentUSD.description: APIEquivalentUSD is the estimated cost had this run been API-billed.
